text:
**Best complete kit: Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 with two 200 W panels.** It pairs a 2,042 Wh battery and 2,200 W output with 400 W of included solar— a more substantial panel bundle than many kits near this capacity. [See the kit’s specs](https://generatorandbackup.com/power-stations/best-solar-generators-home-backup).

If you’d rather prioritize value, consider the **BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kit**. One listing calls it the least-expensive in-stock 2 kWh kit, but its listed bundle includes just one 200 W panel, so solar recharging will be slower. [Compare the BLUETTI kit](https://dealectric.com/best-2000wh-solar-generator-kit-with-panels).

products: BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 + 200 W Solar Panel Kit
judge.why: The answer's top pick is a Jackery Explorer 2000 v2 kit that we don't sell, and its specs come from generatorandbackup.com. The BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 kit, which we do sell, is only a secondary value option.
